note: Sky Wanderer v3 assets. Axes glTF: +Y up, front +Z, 1 unit = 1 m, origin at ground contact unless noted. fps 24. Dim light-me materials are #5b554b; swap to gold by name. No textures except env_* (one 1024 JPEG each).

assets.name: stone_warden
assets.purpose: Enemy 'warden' (R3): rubble golem ~1.85 m, foreign teal rune in chest. Rigid stones on bones. Root motion: none (code moves it); patrol_walk stride 1.0 m/loop. unbind ends as a ~0.55 m rubble step, rune face-up (swap collider to a step).

assets.name: knot_warden
assets.purpose: Boss (l3, ~3.9 m): knotted totem-guardian. Gold cords are separate skinned meshes cord_1 (waist), cord_2 (chest), cord_3 (neck): hide cord_n after unbind_n 'cord_off' event (unbind_1 -> cord_1, unbind_2 -> cord_2, unbind_final -> cord_3). Phase map: 1 idle/ring_cast, 2 chase/ram_telegraph/ram/recover, 3 ring_cast/slam; stagger -> dazed between phases. Code may keep drawing its own cords; then hide cord_* nodes.

assets.name: kestrel
assets.purpose: Tied Kestrel NPC rebuilt with perch clips (perch loop, perch_land / perch_takeoff with root motion on 'body'). Same rig as assets/npc/kestrel.glb; drop-in superset.

assets.name: squall_core
assets.purpose: Squall enemy core: translucent (2,3) knotted-wind tube + emissive eye. Origin = centre (hovers). Spin the whole node in code (yaw ~90 deg/s, faster on telegraph); on unbind scale to 0 and spawn the updraft puff.

assets.name: anchor_bridge
assets.purpose: Anchor-song target: 3-slab span ~5.2 m, origin = centre of the walk top. Rings + chains at both ends; segments are one mesh (crumble = code splits by x thirds or swaps).

assets.name: anchor_slab
assets.purpose: Anchor-song target: floating crumble slab, origin = centre of the walk top (top at z=0). Iron rings + chain stubs on 3 sides. Light 'anchor_glyph' while frozen.
